description: This file implements the cell activation routine for a 5G network, managing configuration updates for cells based on PLMN changes, including handling deactivated cells and generating configuration update messages.

classes.name: cell_activation_routine
classes.description: A class responsible for managing cell activation procedures, including configuration updates based on PLMN changes.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main routine executing the cell activation process asynchronously, updating configurations for each DU.

methods.name: get_plmns_to_activate
methods.description: Determines which PLMNs need to be activated based on the current cell configuration.

methods.name: generate_gnb_cu_configuration_update
methods.description: Generates the configuration update message for gNB-CU based on deactivated cells and PLMN activation status.
